replies.text:
@EXPLOREHORIZONS66 Thank you for your open mind, the most relaxing voice intonation I have ever heard is this video "Das Weltall von A-Z Doku HD"

The stark difference I feel comes down to micro-incongruity. When listening to a professional AI voice, your brain is actively working overtime to process tiny, unnatural errors in phrasing and rhythm, causing subconscious stress. A professional human voice, by contrast, relies on authentic, deeply practiced biological cues that trigger a natural relaxation response in the listener.
Here is exactly why identical scripts feel so different when read by AI versus a human:

1. The "Predictability Trap" vs. Flow

• AI Voice: AI generates audio by predicting the most statistically likely pitch for the next fraction of a second. This results in an eerily perfect, mathematical cadence. Because humans never speak with absolute mathematical consistency, this rigid predictability sets off "uncanny valley" alarms in your brain, keeping you slightly on edge.
• Human Voice: A professional human voice actor uses organic, fluid pacing. They naturally stretch or compress vowels and introduce microscopic imperfections that sound comforting and safe to our biology.

2. Physical Resonance and Breathing

• AI Voice: AI voices do not need to breathe. Even when developers program artificial inhales into the track, the breaths do not actually dictate the pressure, volume, or depth of the words that follow. Your subconscious mind notices this lack of physical connection, which feels unnatural and tense.
• Human Voice: Human speech is entirely bound by the physical body. A professional narrator's deep, rhythmic breathing patterns can actually cause a listener's nervous system to mirror them. This physiological synchronization is a primary reason why human voices feel inherently relaxing.
(source : chatgpt 😉)

I believe AI can never reach human intonation, because it doesn't understand, from an emotional spiritual perspective, what it reads..
